title: Active Record Basics
intro: Active Record basics interview questions for freshers cover the database layer that every Rails developer touches every day. This module covers the ORM concept (the model maps to a database table — Post model → posts table, user_id foreign key), CRUD operations (create/find/find_by/all/where/update/save/destroy) and the bang vs non-bang semantics (save returns boolean, save! raises exception), validations (presence, uniqueness, format) and how to check valid? and read errors.full_messages, basic associations (belongs_to adds the foreign key, has_many is the inverse), dependent: :destroy for cascade deletion, migrations (rails generate model, the change method, db:migrate, db:rollback), schema.rb as the source of truth, and scopes at a basic level. Every answer shows the Ruby code and explains the SQL it produces.
